## Example 1: High Dimensional Expected Shortfall Regression and Inference

In this example, we analyze the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data from 2017 to 2020 to investigate the health disparity in cotinine among different ethnicity groups, through the high dimensional expected shortfall(ES) regression proposed in Zhang et al(2025).
The post-processed dataset contains $n = 2143$ observations and $p = 473$ covariates.
Some key variables are listed as follows:

1. `cotinine`: response variable corresponding the cotinine level.

2. `raceA`: covariate of interest, indicator of Asian group.

3. `raceB`: covariate of interest, indicator of Black group.

3. `raceH`: covariate of interest, indicator of Hispanic group.

### Step 0: Load Data and Necessary Packages

```{r load}
library(haven)
library(quantreg)
library(xtable)
library(survey)
library(conquer)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(estools)

design_matrix = read.csv(paste0('highD.csv'))
y <- design_matrix[,"cotinine"]
x <- subset(design_matrix,select = -c(cotinine))#,overnight2,mental2
x <- x[,-grep("HSQ*",colnames(x))]
x <- as.matrix(x)
p <- ncol(x)
n <- nrow(x)
```


### Step 1: Define the Function to Perform High Dimensional ES Regression and Inference
```{r function}
res <- function(alpha){
  set.seed(1)
  res_est <- lesreg.highdim(x = x, y = y, alpha = alpha, upperTail = TRUE, tuning.method = 'CV',
                            standardize = TRUE)

  ## Asian v.s. White ##
  set.seed(1)
  res_inf1 <- lesreg.highdim.inference(x = x, y = y, alpha = alpha, col = 1, res_est = res_est,
                                       standardize = TRUE, variance.method = 'RCV', upperTail = TRUE)
  theta_1_debias <- res_inf1$theta_debias
  CI1 <- res_inf1$Conf.int

  ## Black v.s. White ##
  set.seed(1)
  res_inf2 <- lesreg.highdim.inference(x = x, y = y, alpha = alpha, col = 2, res_est = res_est,
                                       standardize = TRUE, variance.method = 'RCV', upperTail = TRUE)
  theta_2_debias <- res_inf2$theta_debias
  CI2 = res_inf2$Conf.int

  ## Hispanic v.s. White ##
  set.seed(1)
  res_inf3 <- lesreg.highdim.inference(x = x, y = y, alpha = alpha, col = 3, res_est = res_est,
                                       standardize = TRUE, variance.method = 'RCV', upperTail = TRUE)
  theta_3_debias <- res_inf3$theta_debias
  CI3 <- res_inf3$Conf.int

  ####Summary of Results
  return(list(mean=c(theta_1_debias,theta_2_debias,theta_3_debias),
              lower=c(CI1[1],CI2[1],CI3[1]),
              upper=c(CI1[2],CI2[2],CI3[2]),
              theta_hat = res_est$theta_hat[1:3],
              beta_hat = res_est$beta_hat[1:3]
  ))
}
```


### Step 2: Perform Regression and Inference
```{r, eval=FALSE}
for(tau in seq(from = 0.1, to = 0.3, by = 0.05)){
  res_tau <- res(tau)
  saveRDS(res_tau, file = paste0('highdim_res/tau_', tau, '.rds'))
}

```


### Step 3: Results Analysis and Visualization
```{r analysis}
results <- data.frame()
for(tau in seq(from = 0.1, to = 0.3, by = 0.05)){
  res_tau <- readRDS(paste0('highdim_res/tau_', tau, '.rds'))
  subtab_tau <- cbind(res_tau$mean, res_tau$lower, res_tau$upper, res_tau$theta_hat, res_tau$beta_hat)
  results <- rbind(results, subtab_tau)
}
colnames(results) <- c('mean', 'lower', 'upper', 'theta_hat', 'beta_hat')

results$ci_group <- rep(c("Asian", "Black", "Hispanic"), times = 5)
results$x <- rep(c(0.9,0.85,0.8,0.75,0.7), each = 3)

## plot ##
#pdf(file=paste0('highdim_res/CI_results.pdf'),width=8, height=4)
p1 <- ggplot(results, aes(x = x, y = mean, group = ci_group, color = ci_group)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=ci_group),position = position_dodge(width=0.01),size=4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.01,size=1, position = position_dodge(width=0.01)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Asian" = "red", "Black" = "black", "Hispanic" = "grey")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(18, 17, 16)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_abline(slope=0,intercept=0,linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x = "Quantile level", y = "Disparity in Cotinine (ng/ml)",
       color = "Race",shape="Race")
#dev.off()

p1
```



### Step 4: Comparison with Desparsified Lasso
```{r lasso, echo=TRUE}

library(desla)
H <- c(1,2,3)
despar <- desla(x,y,H)
ci_lasso <- despar$intervals
ci_lasso <- data.frame(ci_lasso)
ci_lasso$ci_group <- c("Asian", "Black", "Hispanic")

```


```{r visual}
####### Lasso plot #####
#pdf(file=paste0('highdim_res/CI_LASSO.pdf'),width=8, height=4)
# Create a numeric variable for x-axis positioning
p2 <- ggplot(ci_lasso, aes(x = ci_group, y = bhat, color = ci_group)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=ci_group),size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = upper.0.05, ymax = lower.0.05), width = 0.05,size=1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Asian" = "red", "Black" = "black", "Hispanic" = "grey")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(18, 17, 16)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_abline(slope=0,intercept=0,linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x = "Race", y = "Disparity in Cotinine (ng/ml)",
       color = "Race",shape="Race") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ylim(c(-214.1389,247.6286))
#dev.off()

p2
```
